entry.title: New: Resolution 381 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO THE FOOD BASKET INC. FOR ITS KŌKUA HARVEST FRUIT STANDS IN COUNCIL DISTRICT 1

Transfers $7,500 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 1)
